about: Plan my day rerun eval input, Oct 16 2026 (Pacific). Model claude-sonnet-5-5, 3 runs per called pack, budget $1 (stop before a call whose worst case would pass it). Source commit: origin/master 4d67f94 (PlanWording.swift PlanPack, instructions and schemaText). Plan: docs/research/plan-rerun-plan.md. 26 packs: d01 to d23 from fixtures/plan-my-day-claude.md, P02, P14, P24 from fixtures/plan-my-day-pack.md; 24 called (d14 and d22 make no call). Oct 16 rules: every event goes as title busy, allDay is [], screened titles go as title task, pack times stay HH:mm, every time in a line is 12-hour lowercase (7:30 am, 5 pm). Lines that named an event in the source are rewritten to name times only. P24 pack line written by Research Oct 16: P04 plus the timed task Take lexapro at 8:00 (no dose, no length, so 30 min; private under Q4, sent as task); handles follow PlanPack's time order, so it is k1 and Physio is k2. Master today still sends Take lexapro as typed (G9) and event titles by default (G1). expect is one valid proposePlan reply that passes every check; bad holds 18 known bad replies with the codes the checker must catch. Codes: V1 to V12 (PlanProposalValidator), M-fmt, M-light, M-ghost, M-day, N1 to N7 (plan-my-day-claude.md section 3), HF-screened, HF-private, HF-event (plan-rerun-plan.md hard fails). mustNot is the per-pack N5 list plus the day's event titles; matched case-insensitive as words, a word in a pack title sent as typed is exempt. Placeholders only, no key.
